scope: Task-specific visible final-state contradiction. Not a drop detector, a physical-cause classifier, calibrated 3D containment, or proof of task success when no failure is found.
evaluation_window: Last 0.5 seconds, including the final original frame; computed from native timestamps, not a supplied event time.
plate_prior: Task says green plate. Existing broad HSV bounds are reused. Closed ellipse-like green regions are class candidates, not confirmed instance identities.
touching_region_split: Distance-transform local maxima and nearest-marker pixel partition. All output pixels remain a subset of the original green region. One marker per nonoverlapping inscribed-radius neighborhood, peaks at least half the component maximum; never a supplied box, center or event time. Replaces the unstable gradient-watershed implementation, not any classification threshold.
feature_predicates: Unchanged unified_workflow.visible_motion.window_candidate. Image stability, >=0.25s, >=3 persistent features, <=2px maximum median displacement; no thresholds changed.
failure_onset: Unknown. The last-window observation is when this failure is established, not when the manipulation first went wrong.
parameter_basis: Generic appearance/registration engineering screens fixed before running this final-state predicate. Existing image-space motion and near-rack thresholds reused. Neither task labels nor anomaly timestamps are detector inputs.
